name: KIC 4737850
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 20.5 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4737850 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 20.5358 +/- 0.3605

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4737850 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 0.936 +/- 0.0367

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4737850 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4268.915 +/- 38.4412

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4737850 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 1.7635 +/- 0.0038

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 0.94 solar masses and 20.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,269 K at its surface.
